title: MChat Fix
description: MChatFix is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that removes chat lag, stutters, and freezes on multiplayer servers. 🚀
body:
💬 MChatFix – Say Goodbye to Chat Lag! 🚀

MChatFix is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that removes chat-related lag, stutters, and freezes on multiplayer servers. ⚡

🎮 In vanilla Minecraft, every chat message is processed on the main game thread. Whenever a message is sent or received, the game briefly pauses to process it, which can cause FPS drops, stuttering, or even freezes—especially on busy servers.

⚔️ This is most noticeable during:

- 🗡️ PvP Battles
- 💎 Crystal PvP
- 🔥 Intense Combat
- 🌍 Crowded Multiplayer Servers

✨ How MChatFix Works
Instead of processing chat on the main thread, MChatFix moves all chat processing to a dedicated background thread. This prevents chat activity from interrupting your gameplay, keeping everything smooth and responsive.

✅ Benefits

- 🚀 Smoother Gameplay
- 📈 Stable FPS
- ❌ No Chat Freezes
- ⚡ Better Performance During PvP
- 💬 Lightweight & Client-Side

«ℹ️ Note: Chat messages may appear with a tiny delay, but your gameplay remains smooth and consistent—making it a worthwhile trade-off for better performance.»
